steps.note: S2.1.3.2 states the net target change (JV+RG)x independently of the initial side and central values a,c, and S2.1.3.1 says rows 6 and 7 restore the scratch wires.
S2.1.3.3 states central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, the side wires cancelling exactly the intersection-one cases, zero and two already zero, and self coefficient one.
S2.1.3.4 states central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2, side cancelling intersections zero and two, intersection one contributing zero, self coefficient one.
S2.1.3.5 gives the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) and S2.1.3 says every invocation restores the scratch wires.
The plan only says every edge joins comparable nested labels (S2.1.5.1.3) and never lists the per-edge orthogonal residuals or their dimensions (the residual table).
S2.1.5.1.4 gives t_X perp t_Y implying <t_X> inside t_Y^perp for edge 2->5, but never gives the complement <t_X,t_Y>^perp or its dimension h-2, so the residual itself is not stated.
Center 3->4 as the only decreasing edge losing h, sources N and sinks Wm-N, telescoping to Wm-2N, and the absolute total Wm-2N+2L are all stated in S2.1.5.1.2 and S2.1.5.1.5 through S2.1.5.1.7.

S2.1.5.1.8 states that over F2 every nonzero residual is nondegenerate and nonalternating (contains a norm-one vector) and so has an orthonormal basis, though it does not describe the absorption of alternating planes.
The plan never states that weight is additive mod 4 for orthogonal binary vectors nor the formula q_V-q_U = sum wt(v)[v.x]; S2.2.1.3 asserts the product-of-kernels result without this derivation.
Nothing in the plan says wt(v) is odd, that the phase is i^{epsilon[v.x]}, or that H diag(1,-1) H = X turns it into a translation kernel; S2.2.1.3 only asserts kernels (aI+bX_v)^{epsilon}.

S2.2.1.8 and S2.2.3.1 state one factor/call per residual vector, each acting on all f axes (columns) of a slot via tensor powers, s_c in total; phrased as child calls rather than the k-column tensor identity.
The plan has no endpoint analysis: no zero-label frame I or full-label C^{tensor m}, no C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a), no Z_{a,k} and i^{27k}Z_{a,k} repair, no negation of the X outputs.
S2.1.5.2.3 states the deficit N-2L_b>0 because L_b<N/2 giving s_b<W_b m, and S2.1.5.1.9 states both loss ratios are below 1/2.
The plan only says the exact deficits exceed 20*2^-50 (S2.1.5.3.1) and never gives eta_b = 339/22587335000000.
The plan never gives eta_c = 73/19906842167500; S2.1.5.3.1 mentions eta_c only through the bound 20*2^-50.
Deficits exceed 20*2^-50, log m<20 from m<2^20, m^{1-2^-50} > m(1-20*2^-50) > m(1-eta), and hence s_b/W_b < m^tau with tau=1-2^-50 are all stated.
Topmost nonzero row with rightmost entry as pivot, clearing by lower-triangular elementary matrices, repeating on active indices, and Pi having exactly a ones are all stated.
S2.1.5.5.1 states a fixed odd prime avoiding every denominator in the finite rational table (and diagonal numerators) so the triangular factors stay invertible mod q^b.
S2.1.5.5.2 states a lower-triangular transformation costs O(V) by updating coordinates in descending physical order using earlier unchanged coordinates.
Each one of Pi is realised by D_j<-D_j+H_i, an interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j, using one interchange per pivot and a in all.
E, B, nu, Delta and C_1=20 appear, but C_0=128mB^2 is never defined, C_1=max{20,nu+3} is not given, and nu=11 is not stated, so the constants are only partly present.
S2.2.4.1 bounds one invocation's operation count below E=64(W+m+1)^3 and S2.2.4.2 states A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E at internal nodes and A(e)<=8e at leaves.
S2.2.4.4 unrolls to A(e)<=8dB^{k+1}<=8B^2d^{nu+1} via B^{log_m d+2}<=B^2d^nu and S2.2.4.5 bounds the total by 128mB^2d^{nu+3}<=C_0d^{C_1}.

Only the epsilon*C_1<1 implies Delta=o(p) part appears; the plan lacks the depth-l facts (2^-(p+l)Z[i], modulus 2^l) and the reserved p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits, giving only the conclusion that growth is at most Delta bits.
S2.2.7 states every row of H has absolute row sum one so disk arrays map to disk arrays and the single truncation errs by less than sqrt2*2^-p.

summary: 17 of 26 sub-steps present. Present: B1-B4, L3-L5, P3, R1, R4, M1-M4, S2, S3, S5. Absent: L1 (no residual table), L2 (no h-2 complement), P1, P2, P4 (phase-interface derivations and endpoints missing), R2, R3 (numeric deficits not given), S1 (C_0 and max-form of C_1 and nu=11 not stated), S4 (depth-to-bits induction and reserved bit widths not stated). No sub-step contradicts the paper.
